title: 第12章 巧合这东西
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
周四下午。

    苏念念没有选修课，按计划可以早回。安槐的丹药常识排在上午，下午也是空的。

    两人收拾完东西正要走，周小鱼从后面追上来。

    “念念，安槐，你们下午干嘛去？”

    “回家。”苏念念说。

    “那你们路过南街吗？上次说好一起去吃那家麻辣烫的，今天正好有空呀。”

    苏念念眼睛一亮，扭头看安槐。

    “去不去？”

    “老大说去就去。”

    “走！”

    三个人出了校门，沿着青岚城的街道往南街方向走，初秋的下午阳光还算温和，街边的梧桐树开始落叶，地上铺了一层金黄色。

    苏念念走在中间，左手端着从校门口小卖部买的冰饮，右手拿着手机翻班级群。

    “哎你们看，群里有人发了药池第二批使用感受，说泡完腰酸背痛。”

    “那是因为他经脉打开得不够，药力渗透的时候产生了排异反应。”安槐随口解释。

    “你泡的时候一点反应都没有？”

    “有，觉得水温刚好，很舒服。”

    苏念念伸手拧了一下他的胳膊。

    “你这不叫反应，这叫泡澡。”

    安槐笑了笑，没反驳。

    三个人拐进南街的时候，周小鱼忽然拉住苏念念的袖子。

    “念念你看，那家麻辣烫是不是换招牌了？”

    苏念念抬头一看，果然，原来写着“老刘麻辣烫”的招牌换成了更大的发光字“南街麻辣烫·总店”，门口还排了十来个人。

    “生意好了啊。”苏念念快步走过去。

    三人排上队，苏念念和周小鱼研究菜单，安槐站在后面帮她们占位置。

    这时候，一个熟悉的声音从前面传来。

    “沈晨同学，你帮我拿一下好不好？我端不动。”

    安槐抬眼看去。

    林落雪站在取餐口，面前摆着两份麻辣烫，大碗，满满当当，沈晨二话不说接过来，还顺手抽了一把纸巾递给她。

    “小心烫。”

    “谢谢你。”林落雪接过纸巾，低头笑了笑。

    安槐收回目光。

    巧合次数加二，周二的灵气感知课是一次，今天在南街又碰上，这是第二次。

    当然，这条街本来就是学校附近最热闹的美食街，碰到同学不算稀奇。

    但安槐注意到一个细节，林落雪点的两份麻辣烫配料几乎一样，说明她不是约了别的朋友来，而是专门跟沈晨两个人来的。

    那么问题来了，她是怎么知道苏念念今天会来南街的？

    答案可能很简单，班级群里，周小鱼前两天就发过消息说“周四下午约念念去吃南街麻辣烫”，还@了好几个人。

    公开信息。

    林落雪只需要翻一翻群记录就能知道。
content_en:
Thursday afternoon.

Su Niannian has no elective courses and can return early as planned.An Huai's elixir knowledge was scheduled in the morning, and it was also empty in the afternoon.

After the two packed up their things and were about to leave, Zhou Xiaoyu caught up with them from behind.

"Niannian, An Huai, why are you going this afternoon?"

"Go home." Su Niannian said.

"Then are you passing by South Street? Last time we agreed to go eat at that spicy restaurant together. We happen to be free today."

Su Niannian's eyes lit up and she turned to look at An Huai.

"Are you going or not?"

"Go as soon as the boss says."

"Let's go!"

The three of them left the school gate and walked along the streets of Qinglan City towards South Street. The sunshine in the early autumn afternoon was still mild. The sycamore trees on the street began to shed their leaves, and the ground was covered with a golden layer.

Su Niannian was walking in the middle, holding an ice drink bought from the canteen at the school gate in her left hand, and scrolling through the class group with her mobile phone in her right hand.

"Hey, look, someone in the group posted their experience of using the second batch of medicinal pool, saying that they had sore backs after soaking in it."

"That's because his meridians were not opened enough and there was a rejection reaction when the medicine penetrated." An Huai explained casually.

"You didn't react at all when you soaked it?"

"Yes, I think the water temperature is just right and very comfortable."

Su Niannian reached out and twisted his arm.

"You don't call this a reaction, this calls you a bath."

An Huai smiled and did not refute.

When the three of them turned into South Street, Zhou Xiaoyu suddenly grabbed Su Niannian's sleeve.

"Nian Nian, look, did that Malatang store change its sign?"

Su Niannian looked up, and sure enough, the sign that originally read "Lao Liu Malatang" was replaced by larger luminous characters "South Street Malatang·Headquarters", and there were about ten people lined up at the door.

"Business is good." Su Niannian walked over quickly.

The three of them lined up, Su Niannian and Zhou Xiaoyu studied the menu, and An Huai stood behind to help them occupy their seats.

At this time, a familiar voice came from the front.

"Classmate Shen Chen, can you help me hold it? I can't carry it."

An Huai looked up.

Lin Luoxue stood at the food retrieval counter, with two portions of Malatang in front of her. The big bowls were full. Shen Chen took them without saying a word, and even took out a handful of tissues and handed them to her.

"Be careful of the burn."

"Thank you." Lin Luoxue took the tissue, lowered her head and smiled.

An Huai looked back.

The number of coincidences plus two is one during the Aura Perception class on Tuesday, and today we met again on South Street. This is the second time.

Of course, this street is the busiest food street near the school, so it is not unusual to meet classmates.

But An Huai noticed one detail. The ingredients for the two spicy soups ordered by Lin Luoxue were almost the same, which meant that she did not invite other friends, but came specifically with Shen Chen.

So the question is, how did she know that Su Niannian would come to South Street today?

The answer may be simple. In the class group, Zhou Xiaoyu sent a message two days ago saying, "I will meet Niannian to eat Nanjie Malatang on Thursday afternoon," and he also @several people.

Public information.

Lin Luoxue only needs to look through the group records to find out.
